Hi Stephanie,

We're kicking off our vendor security assessment for the new contract and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II materials to complete our review. Specifically could you confirm: 

- Whether Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report covering the period that includes 2025-11-01 through 2026-04-30 (our procurement team needs the audit window documented).

- A short list of artifacts we should expect (e.g., SOC 2 PDF, mapping matrix, bridge letter, auditor contact).

We'd like the materials uploaded to a secure link or SFTP. Please advise on the expected timeline — our legal team has a 10-business-day review SLA.

Thanks,

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the clear asks. Short answers up front: we do have a SOC 2 Type II report that covers an audit period ending 2025-12-31 (audit period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31). We cannot extend that period to cover 2026-04-30, but we can provide a bridge letter that summarizes the control posture after the report period and confirms no material control changes through a requested cutoff date.

What we can share immediately: 
- SOC 2 Type II (PDF) — available to signatory contacts under an NDA.
- Bridge letter (auditor-drafted template) — available to procurement teams as a stopgap.
- SOC 2 mapping matrix (CSV) — high-level control-to-policy mapping for reviewer convenience.
- Auditor contact for verification (Ken Wu, ThirdParty Audit LLP).

Recommended next steps so we can get materials to you within your 10-business-day window: 
1) Confirm the recipient email(s) who will sign the sharing agreement (we typically require a single signatory from procurement/legal).
2) Let us know whether you prefer a secure S3 link (pre-signed URL) or an encrypted SFTP transfer.
3) If you need the bridge letter to reference a specific cutoff beyond 2025-12-31, state the requested cutoff date and we will coordinate with the auditor to confirm wording/timebox.

For visibility I copied Rishi (security/compliance) and Laura (legal) who will coordinate attachments and the sharing flow.

Best,

- Sharing flow we will use: 1) Send bridge_letter_sample.docx + soc2_mapping_matrix.csv + redwood_typeii_summary_2025.xlsx over a pre-signed S3 link (expiry 14 days) immediately once Acme provides signatory info for the sharing agreement (we'll accept a short emailed acknowledgement under our standard access terms). 2) Full Type II PDF will be shared after a signed access acknowledgement (we will send a DocuSign link to the procurement signatory).
- Attachment list prepared and uploaded to secure S3 path: https://s3.redwood-inference.com/secure-reports/type-ii-2025.zip (contains summary, mapping, bridge draft).
